messages:
elaine: docs-scan flagged a 404 on KB page `serving/kv-cache` — inline snippet link `s3://rbw-docs/snippets/prefetch.md` returns 404 and image `cache-diagram.svg` is 403. Anyone acting as the document custodian for this page? cc @eng-runtime @devex
ryan: @elaine can you paste the full URL? I can do a quick patch if it's just a path swap.
elaine: full url: https://kb.redwood.ai/serving/kv-cache#prefetch-snippet — clicking the anchor yields 404. I also tried direct asset URL and got 403. (screenshot attached in thread)
docs-bot: link-scan report LS-202103: 1 broken link, 1 restricted asset. Suggested fix: replace `s3://rbw-docs/...` with `https://cdn.redwood.ai/docs/v2/...`.
tim: I touched this page in PR 3456 last quarter. CDN paths were moved to `/docs/v2/` — I can open a tiny PR to swap the link and update the diagram alt text. Will assign to @maria for a quick content check.
maria: sounds fine. if it's literally just S3 -> CDN we can do a docs patch (no deep review). @ryan can you run the link-checker after the change?
ryan: yep — I'll run `tools/link-checker --path serving/kv-cache --fix` once the PR is merged. heads-up: grep shows similar S3 refs under other `serving/` pages.
sana: i'll run a quick scan: `git grep "s3://rbw-docs" docs/ | wc -l` and post results in ~10m.
tim: opened PR: https://git.redwood/repo/docs/pull/4021 — replaces two S3 paths and updates alt text for `cache-diagram.svg`. Commit message: "docs: swap legacy S3 refs -> CDN, add custodian frontmatter".
maria: LGTM, left a tiny nit on alt copy. @deploy-bot can you run the docs preview once this merges? tagging @oncall-docs for visibility.
deploy-bot: deploy request received for branch docs/fix-cdn-links-4021. Preview built at https://staging.kb.redwood.ai/serving/kv-cache?preview=4021.
ryan: ran link-checker on staging — this page shows no 404s now. grep returned 4 more `s3://rbw-docs` occurrences across docs; I'll open a follow-up issue to track bulk migration.
elaine: great. could we also add a one-liner at the top of the KB page: "If you find outdated S3 links, ping #docs or claim the custodian field" — helps future finders.
tim: added that note and also added `custodian: eng-runtime` to frontmatter in the PR update.
maria: merged and deployed to prod. :tada:
deploy-bot: prod deploy succeeded for docs PR 4021 — build 2021.3.45; URL live: https://kb.redwood.ai/serving/kv-cache
elaine: awesome, closing the loop. @sana can you post the grep output and file list and raise the bulk-migration issue?
sana: filing now: https://git.redwood/repo/docs/issues/1287 — includes list of files and suggested replace script. Will assign to docs-team and eng-runtime.
